summary.headline: Sweeps, Steady Hands, and Strong Weekend Efforts
body: The weekend's biggest story was Anna Schiltz and Morehead State sweeping a two-match series at UT-Martin to snap a rough patch, while Elizabeth King and UIC grinded out a five-set road win at Southern Illinois. Other teams had tougher nights, but there were bright spots in every box score.

Anna — Morehead State swept UT-Martin (W 3-1, W 3-1) to close out a strong week. She's now up to 18 kills, 10 digs, and a team-high 14 block assists on the season, showing she can hit, dig, and block at a high level. Her all-around game continues to make her one of the Eagles' most reliable starters.

Elizabeth — UIC lost to Valparaiso (L 1-3) before rallying for a gritty five-set win at Southern Illinois (W 3-2). She's up to 32 kills, 9 digs, and 13 total blocks on the year, and that comeback win showed real fight from the Flames.

Breanna — Roberts Wesleyan dropped two road matches, falling to Queens (L 1-3) and Molloy (L 0-3). She's still running the offense well with 82 assists and 33 digs on the season, and the Red Hawks look to regroup at home against Daemen next.

Kylie — Arkansas Tech lost two tough ones, to Southern Nazarene (L 2-3) and Oklahoma Baptist (L 1-3). She keeps piling up the assists, now at 162 on the season with 42 digs and 13 aces, staying steady even as the results didn't go her way.

players.name: Anna Schiltz
players.blurb: Anna has settled in nicely at right side for the Eagles, putting up 18 kills, 10 digs and a team-high 14 block assists on the season while continuing to start every match. Her all-around game — hitting, digging and blocking — has made her a reliable piece of Morehead State's lineup. The team dropped a tough pair to Lindenwood in late September but bounced right back with back-to-back wins over UT-Martin to close out the first week of October. Next up, Anna and the Eagles host Southern Indiana for a home weekend on October 9 and 10.

players.name: Elizabeth King
players.blurb: Elizabeth has been a steady contributor for UIC this season, picking up 32 kills and 9 digs while chipping in 13 total blocks and 2 service aces across her 15 matches played. The Flames had a mixed stretch in late September into October, dropping matches to Illinois State, Belmont and Valparaiso before rallying for a hard-fought 3-2 win at Southern Illinois. Elizabeth and the team are back in action at home on Oct. 9 at Credit Union 1 Arena.

buzz.title: Conference Openers and Road Trips Fill the Weekend
body: It's a busy weekend across the board, with Anna's Eagles kicking off a two-match OVC series at UT Martin and Breanna's Redhawks opening ECC play at Queens. Elizabeth and the Flames look for their first MVC win at Southern Illinois, while Gracyn's Bulldogs and Peyton's Spartans both keep their seasons moving at home and on the road.

Anna — Morehead State heads to UT Martin for a Friday-Saturday OVC series, 6 PM CT Friday and 2 PM CT Saturday, both on ESPN+. She's been a steady two-way presence on the right side with 18 kills and 14 block assists so far, and the Eagles are hoping to turn things around as league play heats up.
Elizabeth — UIC travels to Southern Illinois on Saturday at 5 PM CT, no stream listed. After a rough patch of MVC losses, the Flames are looking for their first conference win of the year.
Gracyn — Gardner-Webb hosts Charleston Southern Saturday at 3 PM CT at Paul Porter Arena. She's still waiting for her first match action, but the Runnin' Bulldogs keep rolling at 6-4 overall.
Breanna — Roberts Wesleyan opens ECC play at Queens College Saturday at 11 AM CT, streaming on FloSports. She's been the engine of the Redhawks' offense all season, piling up 55 assists and 24 digs.
Catherine — McHenry County hosts Elgin Community College Thursday, no time listed. She's still working her way into the Scots' lineup this fall.

Peyton — Elgin CC plays a Saturday doubleheader at South Suburban, facing Moraine Valley at 9 AM CT and Malcolm X College at 11 AM CT. She hasn't seen match time yet, but the Spartans keep battling at 8-8 on the year.

buzz.title: Anna Steady, Kylie Hits Ten Aces, Mixed Results
body: It was a mixed weekend for the group — Anna kept grinding on both sides of the net for Morehead State even in a rough Lindenwood sweep, while Kylie hit a nice personal milestone of 10 career aces during a split week for Arkansas Tech. Trevecca kept rolling with another win, and a few of the girls are still waiting for their first minutes.

Anna — Morehead State dropped both matches to Lindenwood at home (L 0-3, L 0-3), but Anna stayed a dependable two-way presence on the right side, continuing to add to her season totals of 18 kills, 10 digs, and 14 block assists. She's been steady at the net and in the back row all fall. The Eagles look to bounce back with a home-and-home at UT Martin next.

Elizabeth — UIC lost both matches this week, falling to Illinois State (L 1-3) and Belmont (L 0-3). She's continued to contribute on the front line with solid hitting and blocking numbers on the season, and the Flames now turn to Valparaiso next.

Gracyn — Gardner-Webb fell in their conference opener to Winthrop and dropped a tough five-setter to Wofford. Gracyn didn't see the court this week but keeps working in practice as the Bulldogs push further into their schedule.

Kylie — Arkansas Tech split the week, beating Ouachita Baptist 3-1 before falling to Harding in straight sets. Kylie passed 10 career aces along the way while adding to her season marks of 150 assists and 39 digs, another steady week running the offense.
Mary — Trevecca kept it rolling with a 3-1 win over Christian Brothers. Mary didn't see the court this week, but the Trojans stay hot heading into their home match with Kentucky Wesleyan.

buzz.title: Openers, Milestones, and a Sweet Reunion Weekend
body: This weekend brings conference play into full swing for several of the girls, with Anna opening OVC action and Elizabeth hosting a pair of MVC matches after a milestone night. Mary's Trojans look for more Gulf South wins, while up in Minnesota, Layla and Peyton Strout will share a court for the first time this season as rivals.
Anna — Morehead State hosts Lindenwood Fri 5 PM CT and Sat 1 PM CT on ESPN+; it's the Eagles' OVC opener after a tough non-conference stretch.
Elizabeth — UIC hosts Illinois State Fri 6 PM CT and Belmont Sat 2 PM CT, both streaming on ESPN+; she just picked up her 25th college kill last week.
Gracyn — Gardner-Webb hosts Winthrop Sat 3 PM CT at Paul Porter Arena; a Big South opener as the Runnin' Bulldogs look to keep their winning ways going.
Layla — Winona State hosts Concordia-St. Paul Thu 6 PM CT, then travels to Minnesota State Mankato Sat 2 PM CT on Midco Sports+; that match doubles as a reunion with Peyton Strout.
Mary — Trevecca hosts Union (Tenn.) Fri 6 PM CT and Christian Brothers Sat 2 PM CT on FloSports; home matches as the Trojans keep building in Gulf South play.
Peyton — Minnesota State hosts Winona State Sat 2 PM CT on Midco Sports+, a fun reunion match against Layla Merlin's Warriors.

buzz.title: A Milestone Week, Two Sweeps, and Steady Progress
body: It was a busy weekend across the country — Elizabeth King passed 25 college kills and helped UIC grind out a five-set win over Loyola, while Gracyn Sanders and Kylie Lambert both picked up sweeps for teams on winning streaks. A few other girls are still waiting for their first match reps, but everyone's staying in the mix.
Anna — Morehead State dropped both matches to Marshall this weekend (L 0-3, L 0-3), but Anna kept her spot starting at right side and has 16 kills and 10 blocks on the season.
Elizabeth — UIC lost to DePaul and Northern Illinois but bounced back to beat Loyola in five sets; she also crossed 25 career kills along the way.
Gracyn — Gardner-Webb swept both Southern Illinois and Austin Peay this weekend, and Gracyn's hitting .333 on the year with 10 kills in limited action.
Kylie — Arkansas Tech kept rolling with a sweep of Arkansas-Monticello and a four-set win over Southern Arkansas; Kylie's up to 121 assists and 35 digs running the offense.
Layla — Winona State lost to Wayne State and Augustana this week; Layla is still waiting for her first match action as a freshman.
Mary — Trevecca split the week, falling to Valdosta State but sweeping Auburn Montgomery; Mary hasn't gotten into a match yet this season.

buzz.title: A Big Volleyball Weekend Ahead
body: It's a packed few days for the girls, with Elizabeth playing three matches in three days, Gracyn opening a big tournament in Tennessee, and Anna facing Marshall twice as Morehead State tries to build on its recent win streak. A few of the girls are also opening conference play this weekend, so there's plenty to cheer for.
Anna — Morehead State at Marshall Fri 4 PM CT, then home vs Marshall Sat 1 PM CT, both on ESPN+; back-to-back games give the Eagles a shot to keep their momentum going after three straight wins.
Elizabeth — UIC at Loyola Thu 6 PM CT, at Northern Illinois Fri 6 PM CT, at DePaul Sat 5 PM CT, all on ESPN+; a busy road stretch right after her first career dig and block assist last week.

Gracyn — Gardner-Webb opens a tournament in Clarksville, TN: Austin Peay Fri 12 PM CT, Southern Illinois Fri 3 PM CT, SIUE Sat 10 AM CT; three matches in two days as the Bulldogs head toward Big South play.
Breanna — Roberts Wesleyan hosts Assumption Sat 1 PM CT and Saint Michael's Sun 1 PM CT, both on FloSports; a chance for the Redhawks to pick up home wins.
Kylie — Arkansas Tech hosts Southern Arkansas Thu 6 PM CT on the GAC Network, then travels to Arkansas-Monticello Fri 4 PM CT; the Golden Suns are 1-0 in conference and looking to stay unbeaten.
Layla — Winona State at Wayne State Fri 6 PM CT and at Augustana Sat 5 PM CT, both on MidcoSportsPlus; we'll be watching closely for her first minutes of the season.
Mary — Trevecca opens Gulf South play at Auburn-Montgomery Fri 5 PM CT, then at Valdosta State Sat 12 PM CT, both on FloSports; a fresh start as the Trojans dive into conference games.
Peyton — Elgin CC travels to Lewis & Clark Sat 10 AM CT; no stream listed, but a good chance for her to log more court time.

buzz.title: A Full Weekend of Matches Ahead

Anna — Morehead State at Marshall Friday 4 PM CT, then hosts Marshall Saturday 1 PM CT, both on ESPN+. A home-and-home gives the Eagles two chances to bounce back after last week's losses.

Elizabeth — UIC plays three straight Valley road matches: Loyola Thursday 6 PM CT, NIU Friday 6 PM CT, DePaul Saturday 5 PM CT, all on ESPN+. She just picked up her first college dig and block assist, so keep an eye on her stat line growing.

Gracyn — Gardner-Webb plays three matches in Clarksville, TN: Austin Peay Friday noon CT, Southern Illinois Friday 3 PM CT, and SIUE Saturday 10 AM CT. The Runnin' Bulldogs have won four of their last six, so momentum is on their side.
Kylie — Arkansas Tech hosts Southern Arkansas Thursday 6 PM CT on GAC Sports Network to open conference play, then travels to Arkansas-Monticello Friday 4 PM CT. The Golden Suns start 1-0 in the GAC.
Layla — Winona State travels to Wayne State Friday 6 PM CT and Augustana Saturday 5 PM CT, both on MidcoSportsPlus. The Warriors are still looking to build momentum in NSIC play.
Mary — Trevecca is on the road at Auburn-Montgomery Friday 5 PM CT and Valdosta State Saturday noon CT, both on FloSports. The Trojans are still chasing their first GSC win.
Peyton — Elgin CC travels to Lewis & Clark Community College Saturday 10 AM CT, her only match this weekend as she keeps working into the libero/DS rotation.
